```sql
SELECT
    district,
    CASE
        WHEN women_enrolled IS NULL OR women_enrolled = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * employed_at_6_months / women_enrolled
    END AS employed_pct
FROM livelihoods
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY employed_pct ASC;
```
